mapper.sql: CASE WHEN a.field_name IN ('assignee', 'assignee_id') AND a.old_value IS NOT NULL AND a.old_value SIMILAR TO '[0-9]+' THEN COALESCE(old_user.display_name, a.old_value) ELSE a.old_value END AS old_value, CASE WHEN a.field_name IN ('assignee', 'assignee_id') AND a.new_value IS NOT NULL AND a.new_value SIMILAR TO '[0-9]+' THEN COALESCE(new_user.display_name, a.new_value) ELSE a.new_value END AS new_value

LEFT JOIN sys_user old_user ON old_user.id = CASE WHEN a.field_name IN ('assignee', 'assignee_id') AND a.old_value IS NOT NULL AND a.old_value SIMILAR TO '[0-9]+' THEN CAST(a.old_value AS BIGINT) ELSE NULL END LEFT JOIN sys_user new_user ON new_user.id = CASE WHEN a.field_name IN ('assignee', 'assignee_id') AND a.new_value IS NOT NULL AND a.new_value SIMILAR TO '[0-9]+' THEN CAST(a.new_value AS BIGINT) ELSE NULL END
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.description, i.issue_type, i.status_id, i.priority, i.assignee_id, i.reporter_id, i.sprint_id, i.parent_id, i.due_date, i.estimated_hours, i.spent_hours, i.custom_fields, i.resolved_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.version, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status, s.name AS status_name, s.code AS status_code, s.color AS status_color, s.category AS status_category, s.is_default AS status_is_default, s.is_closed AS status_is_closed, a.display_name AS assignee_name, r.display_name AS reporter_name, sp.name AS sprint_name, pi.issue_key AS parent_key FROM issue i LEFT JOIN project p ON p.id = i.project_id LEFT JOIN issue_status s ON s.id = i.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = i.assignee_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON r.id = i.reporter_id LEFT JOIN sprint sp ON sp.id = i.sprint_id LEFT JOIN issue pi ON pi.id = i.parent_id AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.issue_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.source, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.display_name AS user_name, u.avatar_url AS user_avatar FROM issue_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.issue_id = #{issueId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT a.id, a.issue_id, a.user_id, a.action, a.field_name, , a.detail, a.created_at, u.display_name AS user_name FROM issue_activity a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id
WHERE a.issue_id = #{issueId} ORDER BY a.created_at ASC

SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.issue_type, i.priority, i.deleted_at, a.display_name AS assignee_name, d.display_name AS deleted_by_name FROM issue i LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = i.assignee_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT user_id FROM issue_activity WHERE issue_id = i.id AND action = 'deleted' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) act ON true LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON d.id = act.user_id WHERE i.project_id = #{projectId} AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.deleted_at DESC
SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.issue_type, i.priority, i.deleted_at, i.assignee_id, i.reporter_id, i.sprint_id, i.status_id FROM issue i WHERE i.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE issue SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM issue WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.issue_type, i.priority, s.name AS status_name, s.color AS status_color, s.category AS status_category, u.display_name AS assignee_name FROM issue i LEFT JOIN issue_status s ON s.id = i.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.assignee_id WHERE i.parent_id = #{parentId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE issue SET parent_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
